title: Dynamic Preference "Reversals" and Time Inconsistency
title_zh: 动态偏好“逆转”与时间不一致性
authors: Philipp Strack, Dmitry Taubinsky
abstract: We study the possibility of identifying time-inconsistent preferences in empirical designs where preferences are elicited in advance at time 0 and then again at time 1, after the agent receives additional information. For single-peaked preferences, time consistency is rejected only when the time-1 ranking between a pair of alternatives is always the reverse of the time-0 ranking. We establish variations and generalizations of this result. Since such stark reversals are rarely observed, choice-revision designs require stronger identification assumptions than perhaps previously appreciated. But we show that time inconsistency is identifiable in environments where preferences over alternatives can be “priced out.” (JEL D11, D15, D83, D86)
abstract_zh: 我们研究了在实证设计中识别时间不一致偏好的可能性，其中偏好是在时间0提前引出，并在时间1（代理人获得额外信息后）再次引出。对于单峰偏好，只有当时间1对某对备选方案的排序始终与时间0的排序相反时，时间一致性才被拒绝。我们建立了这一结果的变体与推广形式。由于这种截然相反的逆转现象极少被观察到，选择修正设计所需的识别假设可能比以往所认知的更为严格。但我们证明，在能够对备选方案偏好进行“定价”的环境中，时间不一致性是可识别的。（JEL D11, D15, D83, D86）

title: Competing Diffusions in a Social Network
title_zh: 社交网络中的竞争性扩散
authors: Campbell, Arthur, Leister, C. Matthew, Ushchev, Philip, Zenou, Yves
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We develop a model of competing diffusions of goods on a social network. There are two types of goods and individuals: mass-market and niche-market. We find that there is a unique stable steady state and show that the adoption of a massmarket good is greater than its population share. Furthermore, greater connectivity and homophily in the social network will concurrently increase the prevalence of niche-market goods. If there is a strategic agent who wants to promote a niche good, she will invest more in influencing activities than one promoting mass-market goods. When individuals choose their degree of homophily, we show that niche-market individuals exhibit greater homophily than mass-market ones.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个社交网络中商品竞争性扩散的模型。模型包含两类商品与两类个体：大众市场型与利基市场型。研究发现存在唯一稳定的稳态，且大众市场型商品的采纳率高于其人口占比。此外，社交网络中的更高连通性与同质性会同时提升利基市场型商品的普及程度。若存在战略代理人试图推广利基商品，其投入的影响活动成本将高于推广大众市场型商品的代理人。当个体自主选择同质性程度时，我们证明利基市场型个体比大众市场型个体表现出更强的同质性。

title: Job Ads as Signals: Evidence from a Priced Amenity and Worker Beliefs
title_zh: 职位广告作为信号：来自定价福利与工人信念的证据
authors: Pawel Adrjan, Mária Balgova, Simon Jäger, Jonas Jessen, Jason Sockin
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Discrete choice experiments are widely used to estimate workers’ willingness to pay (WTP) for job amenities under the assumption that varying an attribute does not change workers’ beliefs about other job attributes. We test this assumption by embedding an amenity with a known market price—a popular monthly public transport pass—in a largescale discrete choice experiment with German workers. Many workers, including public transport users, overvalue the ticket by more than 100%, despite WTP for other attributes aligning with the literature. A complementary belief-elicitation experiment shows that advertising an amenity, such as the pass but also common amenities like work from home, causally shifts beliefs about unlisted attributes of the job. Posted wages similarly signal unlisted attributes so that wage variation, the money metric for WTP calculation, is itself contaminated by belief spillovers—such as higher pay signaling heightened stress. These spillovers imply that discrete choice estimates capture perceived bundles rather than isolated attributes, and distort current estimates of non-wage compensation and monopsony power.
abstract_zh: 离散选择实验被广泛用于估算工人对工作福利的支付意愿，其前提假设是改变某一属性不会改变工人对其他工作属性的信念。我们通过将一项具有已知市场价格的福利——德国广受欢迎的月度公共交通通票——嵌入针对德国工人的大规模离散选择实验来检验这一假设。结果显示，许多工人（包括公共交通使用者）对该通票的估值高出实际价值100%以上，尽管对其他属性的支付意愿与现有文献一致。一项补充性的信念诱导实验表明，宣传某项福利（如通票，也包括居家办公等常见福利）会因果性地改变工人对工作未列明属性的信念。同样，公布的工资水平也会传递未列明属性的信号，因此作为支付意愿计算货币尺度的工资变动本身也受到信念溢出效应的影响——例如高薪可能意味着更高的工作压力。这些溢出效应意味着离散选择实验的估计结果捕捉到的是感知到的福利组合而非孤立属性，从而扭曲了当前对非工资补偿和买方垄断势力的估算。

title: Beyond Metropolitan Averages: Food Demand Across Local Markets
title_zh: 超越都市均值：地方市场的食品需求
authors: Justin D. Bina
abstract: ABSTRACT Demand estimates are commonly used to inform firm strategy and public policy, yet they can obscure important variation in demand across geographic space that is relevant for local business decisions and policy interventions. Prior work documents demand heterogeneity across countries, regions, states, and between coarse urban‐rural categories, but evidence on sub‐metropolitan variation is limited. This study documents within‐metro geographic heterogeneity in market shares and willingness‐to‐pay (WTP) for retail and foodservice protein products. I use nearly six years of publicly available survey data and random parameters logit models that include municipality interactions with alternative‐specific constants and price sensitivity to estimate municipality‐specific market shares and WTP in the Phoenix metropolitan area. Demand varies substantially across adjacent municipalities. Central Phoenix residents exhibit higher retail WTP for conventional beef, pork, and chicken products, while both central Phoenix and Scottsdale‐Tempe residents show consistently higher foodservice WTP. Median WTP in these municipalities is roughly 30–50% higher than in surrounding suburbs, whereas suburban groups exhibit similar valuations to one another. These within‐metro differences are large enough to affect targeted pricing and assortment strategies and to produce uneven distributional welfare effects from local price policies (e.g., taxes). The results suggest that investment in geographically refined demand analyses could better inform policy interventions and business decisions at the local level, where those decisions are often made.
abstract_zh: 摘要 需求估计常用于指导企业战略和公共政策，但可能掩盖地理空间上需求的重要差异，而这些差异与地方商业决策和政策干预密切相关。已有研究记录了国家、地区、州以及城乡粗分类之间的需求异质性，但关于大都市内部次区域差异的证据仍然有限。本研究揭示了凤凰城大都市区内零售和餐饮服务蛋白质产品市场份额及支付意愿（WTP）的地理异质性。利用近六年的公开调查数据，通过随机参数Logit模型（包含市政区与替代特定常数及价格敏感性的交互项），估算了凤凰城大都市区各市政区的市场份额和支付意愿。相邻市政区之间的需求存在显著差异。凤凰城市中心居民对传统牛肉、猪肉和鸡肉产品的零售支付意愿更高，而凤凰城市中心及斯科茨代尔-坦佩居民的餐饮服务支付意愿始终较高。这些市政区的支付意愿中位数比周边郊区高出约30-50%，而郊区群体之间的估值则较为接近。这种大都市内部差异足以影响针对性的定价和品类策略，并导致地方价格政策（如税收）产生不均衡的福利分配效应。研究结果表明，投资于地理精细化需求分析，能够更好地为地方层面的政策干预和商业决策提供信息，而这类决策通常正是在地方层面做出的。

title: Citizenship Policy and the Spread of Communicable Diseases: Evidence from the Dominican Republic
title_zh: 国籍政策与传染病传播：来自多米尼加共和国的证据
authors: Fabiola Alba-Vivar, Eduardo Campillo-Betancourt, Jose Luis Flor-Toro
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study how fatal and nonfatal health shocks affect households’ ability to meet their financial obligations. We find that fatal shocks substantially increase the likelihood of default and that housing wealth plays a key role as a self-insurance mechanism. Surviving spouses who experience the largest income losses are more likely to sell their homes, and those without housing wealth face a sharply higher risk of debt collection. In the most financially vulnerable families, these shocks even generate intergenerational spillovers. In contrast, nonfatal health shocks lead to only modest increases in default risk. Taken together, our findings suggest that strengthening survivors’ benefits for households with limited resources could improve welfare across generations.

authors: Pinghan Liang, Shu Tian, Yichuan Zhang
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Conventional demographic models systematically overestimate fertility decline in sub-Saharan Africa. This paper proposes a complementary explanation grounded in a prevalent but understudied belief system: ancestors influence the living and seek the continuation of their lineage, into which they may be reincarnated. In this worldview, having children becomes a moral and collective duty, rooted in the spiritual responsibility to ensure the survival of the lineage. Drawing on first-hand data, novel ethnographic information, and historical and contemporary surveys, I document a strong and quantitatively large positive relationship between ancestral beliefs and fertility across contexts and time periods. A simple model in which children are a public good for the lineage rationalizes the patterns observed in the data: the fertility effect of ancestral beliefs is concentrated in patrilineal societies, and a specific form of free-riding emerges among siblings whose children continue the same family line. These findings suggest that high fertility in sub-Saharan Africa rests on moral foundations that standard, externally designed interventions tend to overlook.

title: The Private Provision of Public Services: Evidence from Random Assignment in Medicaid
title_zh: 公共服务的私人提供：来自医疗补助随机分配的证据
authors: Danil Agafiev Macambira, Michael Geruso, Anthony Lollo, Chima D. Ndumele, Jacob Wallace
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines the effects of privatizing social health insurance. We exploit a natural experiment in Medicaid, wherein nearly 100,000 enrollees were randomly assigned between a publicly operated fee-for-service system and private managed care. Managed care reduced costs by 5.6 percent via cost-effective substitutions among prescription drugs and via lower prices for outpatient services. We present evidence that pharmacy utilization management was the key mechanism reducing overuse and encouraging substitution to lower-cost drugs without decreasing observed quality. In contrast, privatizing medical benefits led to only modest savings and was associated with decreased health care quality and consumer satisfaction. (JEL G22, H41, I13, I18, I38)

title: Gender Criteria Gap in Evaluation: Role of Perceived Intentions and Outcomes
title_zh: 评价中的性别标准差距：感知意图与结果的作用
authors: Nisvan Erkal, Lata Gangadharan, Boon Han Koh
abstract: ABSTRACT We investigate whether different criteria are used in evaluating male and female leaders when outcomes are determined by unobservable choices and luck. Evaluators form beliefs about leaders’ choices (perceived intentions) and make discretionary payments. We find that while payments to male leaders are determined by both outcomes and perceived intentions, those to female leaders are determined by outcomes only. We label this new source of gender bias as the gender criteria gap . Our findings imply that high outcomes are necessary for women to get bonuses, but men can receive bonuses for low outcomes if evaluators hold them in high regard.
